title: bouteloua polymorpha
intro: Bouteloua polymorpha, commonly known as Blue Grama Grass, is a perennial grass native to the Great Plains region of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Grama Grass include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
